Title: Introduction to Backpropagation
Summary: This chapter introduces backpropagation as the core algorithm enabling neural networks to learn. It outlines the video's goal: providing an intuitive walkthrough of backpropagation without relying on complex formulas, setting the stage for a deeper mathematical exploration in the next video. The video establishes foundational knowledge required to understand backpropagation, including neural network structure, forward propagation, gradient descent, and the concept of minimizing a cost function. It focuses on the classic task of recognizing handwritten digits using the MNIST dataset.
